title: 2005 – The 1st WTIA SMS Donation Campaign
author: hkwtia
plainText: WTIA and Internet Professionals Association (iProA) partnered with mobile network operators in Hong Kong to launch an SMS Donation Campaign, and raised HK $2 million for the victims of 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami.
